label: Synthesis
title: Synthesis
subtitle: Synthesises information from multiple sources to identify patterns, conflicts, consensus, and gaps. Produces a structured analysis output that combines findings from different agents or data sources.
whenToUse: Use after a research or data-gathering phase when you need an agent to integrate findings across several sources — useful at the end of a literature review, after multi-agent data collection, or when comparing results.

methods.name: Synthesise Sources
methods.description: Comprehensive synthesis with consensus, conflict, and gap analysis across the provided sources.

methods.name: Analyse Patterns
methods.description: Identifies recurring patterns and correlations across sources without producing a full synthesis.

methods.name: Integrate Findings
methods.description: Combines findings from multiple agents into a unified output with recommended next steps.

mediaCaption: A synthesis result card in the chat showing sections for consensus findings, identified conflicts, and gaps in the evidence
tips: Synthesis works best when sources have been gathered in a structured format — use the Scratch Pad or Data Layer to collect them first.
